name: Sima Feedback
author: simafeedback

sections.description:
Say goodbye to endless email chains—get feedback where it matters most.

Impress your clients with the smoothest review process on the market. Sima provides a truly frictionless reviewer experience, no login required.

Sima natively integrates with your existing workflow. Comfortable with your existing tools? So is Sima.

Third-Party Services

Sima Feedback integrates with Sima Feedback to provide visual feedback features on your website. When activated, the plugin loads an external script from https://www.simafeedback.com/sima.js.

  • Service URL: https://www.simafeedback.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.simafeedback.com/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policies of Sima Feedback.
sections.faq:
What does Sima mean?
Sima is a Persian word that means face (or beautiful face). It seemed relevant as comments are no longer lost in emails, but instead appear \”on the surface\” of a site.

What does Sima do?
Sima is a visual feedback tool that enables users to provide clear and actionable feedback on websites. Sima also integrates with product management tools to help manage and track feedback.
